name: Agentic Software Factory
description: Portable, tool-agnostic agentic software-factory pipeline. Single source of truth: the orchestrator agent and the board renderer both read this file. Edit here to add/remove/reorder stages, swap agents, change the default skill per phase, or re-point loopbacks. Per-phase skill OVERRIDES live in factory.skills.json (that file wins over the `skill` default below).

stages.label: Intake
stages.description: Normalize the raw demand into a clear, scoped problem statement with context, constraints and mapped reference IDs.

stages.label: Spec Generator
stages.description: Turn the intake into a technical specification: requirements, design, data touchpoints, interfaces and a task breakdown.

stages.label: Acceptance Criteria
stages.description: Derive testable, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria from the spec. These are the contract every reviewer verifies against.

stages.label: Builder Engineer
stages.description: Implement the spec to satisfy the acceptance criteria. Re-entered on every loopback from a reviewer.

stages.label: Code Reviewer
stages.description: Behavioral and structural review of the diff: correctness, security, conventions, tests, scope.

stages.label: UI Reviewer
stages.description: Visual correctness against the style guide: layout, tokens, responsiveness, iconography, states. N/A when there is no UI surface.

stages.label: UX Reviewer
stages.description: Flow, clarity, accessibility and information architecture. N/A when there is no user-facing flow.

stages.label: Acceptance Review
stages.description: Verify every acceptance criterion from phase 20 is met, with evidence (tests, output, repro steps).

stages.label: Approver
stages.description: Final gate. Confirms all prior stages passed and traceability is complete, then approves or rejects the demand.
